is.t: Coefficient of every feature in the two fixed sets (285 metabolic Pfam domains, 38 non-NARP anti-defense profiles), with the saved opportunity diagnostics of the same fits (fixed-opportunity cloglog model, free exponent gamma, logit projection and their validity/warnings)

slope in log-odds per 10-fold increase in CDS count; se and cluster_se on the same scale; carriers are reference genomes. The unit and model columns describe the ordinary logit only; null_logit_equivalent and residual_slope are on the slope scale; gamma, gamma_se and gamma_unaccepted_estimate are dimensionless (see FIELDS). Empty gamma where gamma_valid is FALSE
Median coefficient and sign counts of each fixed set
median in log-odds per 10-fold CDS; the median describes the set and is not a test between sets
Carrier genomes and gene-sharing clusters behind each of the 38 profiles
genomes and clusters; a single cluster is not a single genome and clusters are not a phylogeny
The six saved local bins of predicted genes per recovered vOTU (kept here because they are plotted in Figure 5A)
intervals are left-closed [lo, hi); n and k are vOTUs; rate is a fraction. This is the only local table in Supplementary Data 2
Validity of the separate ecosystem and host-phylum adjustments for the fixed comparison
counts of features that were not estimable; the two adjustments are separate models and neither controls for the other
Firth sensitivity fits, unadjusted and under each separate adjustment
How often the full fixed comparison was estimable in each resampling scheme (summary of G17)

replicates; median is the median over valid replicates of (METAB median - ADF median) in log-odds per 10-fold CDS, not a coefficient median of one set; the percentile range of valid replicates is not a confidence interval
Stratum sizes of the ecosystem and host-phylum labels
reference genomes; host labels are annotations, not measured host range
The six NAD-pathway domains and the metabolic median with and without them
slopes and medians in log-odds per 10-fold CDS
Global-side analyses that were not done, are incomplete, or were not established in the source project; original S4 wording in the saved records now refers to Supplementary Note 4
Every per-feature fit of the two separate adjustments, including the ones that were not estimable
slope in log-odds per 10-fold CDS; valid marks an estimable fit; warnings as saved by the fitting run
Every per-feature Firth-penalised fit behind the medians of Supplementary Note 4

both slope and raw_slope are the same Firth-penalised coefficient (log-odds per 10-fold CDS): raw_slope is the value before the validity filter, slope is kept only where valid is TRUE. Neither is an unpenalised estimate; for unpenalised fits see G01 (unadjusted) and G11 (separate adjustments)
Per-feature fits within each ecosystem and host-phylum stratum
slope as above; n is the stratum size in reference genomes; carriers are genomes within that stratum

slope as above; unit names the historical aggregation unit
HISTORICAL, withdrawn, audit only: profile-to-unit membership under the old direct join (equals G22 old_unit). Corrected mapping in G22 and G24
text; selected38 is a TRUE/FALSE flag
Run parameters of the Firth sensitivity fits

difference in log-odds per 10-fold CDS, empty when the replicate is not valid; n_invalid_metab and n_invalid_adf count features that could not be fitted in that replicate
Per-replicate, per-feature diagnostics behind G17: which feature failed in which replicate, with its carrier count and warning text
carriers are reference genomes in that replicate; slope in log-odds per 10-fold CDS, empty when not estimable; warnings are the fitting warnings as saved
Status of the historical, withdrawn and post hoc corrected global aggregation results and of the current fixed baseline, by sheet and rows
text; status labels are the repair run's own where saved, otherwise a summary of the saved record (label_origin); none is a validation grade
Saved scenario summary of the post hoc repair of the category join: fixed 285 and 38 baselines, two corrected category definitions (9 and 10 units), and the withdrawn legacy_mixed (22)
medians and differences in log-odds per 10-fold CDS; corrected scenarios change the statistical units and weights and are not replicates of the 38-profile parameter
All 364 saved fits of the repair run, with logit, fixed-opportunity, free-exponent and projection fields, validity flags and warnings as saved

slope in log-odds per 10-fold CDS; gamma dimensionless; opportunity fields computed for the 19 corrected categories only; null_equivalent_valid is FALSE and observed_minus_null_slope NA for all 19, as saved
The 104 observed anti-defense profiles: corrected category, historical old-join unit and whether the mapping changed
carriers are reference genomes; text and TRUE/FALSE flags

Census expansion of 356 profiles to subtypes and categories used by the repair
All categories compared between the two corrected scenarios, including unchanged membership and eligibility
profiles and reference genomes; eligibility is carriers ≥ 30
323 feature-level projection reproductions with original flags, numerical warnings and two coefficient cross-checks.
